notes: Changes the mode of a JSONAssert.assertEquals call from JSONCompareMode.STRICT_ORDER to JSONCompareMode.LENIENT. Both modes are extensible, so the only check dropped is the order of array elements, as STRICT to NON_EXTENSIBLE drops it for a non extensible comparison. Accepted with no code: STRICT_ORDER to LENIENT is on the order only allowlist of the strict assertion principle (kind 2). Adapted: no merged change was found that makes this move on its own.
